test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following types of piston ring is placed at the top of the piston in an IC engine?
solution:
The correct answer is __Compression ring**(Option 2)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Compression ring__ is placed at the top of the piston in an IC engine.
 
• The compression ring helps to seal the combustion chamber and prevents the leakage of gases during the combustion process.
 
• It plays a vital role in ensuring efficient combustion and engine performance.
 
• Compression rings are designed to withstand high temperatures and pressures generated in the combustion chamber.
 
• They are usually made of high-strength materials such as cast iron or alloy steel.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Oil Ring:**

 
 
• The oil ring is used to control the amount of oil on the cylinder walls.
 
• It prevents excessive oil from reaching the combustion chamber.
 
 
 
• **Wiper Ring:**
 
 
• Also known as the scraper ring, it removes excess oil from the cylinder walls.
 
• It is positioned below the compression ring.
 
 
 
• **Pressure Ring:**
 
 
• This term is sometimes used interchangeably with the compression ring.
 
• Its main function is to seal the combustion chamber and withstand pressure.
